purpose: The draft stage's chip install (owner, 2026-11-18: "improve drastically"): seven bespoke cues for the Unity Chip Arena effects bank. Until generated, each plays as layers of existing bank keys (Core/NativeInstallShot.Cues); once its key has clips it replaces those layers. Contract: docs/audio/SOUND-REQUESTS.md. Generation is a paid step, run by the owner or Astra (docs/audio/SOUND-GENERATOR.md).
